title: Zyn Calls Rose
style: 92 bpm, lo-fi boom-bap, rainy night, vinyl crackle, jazzy keys, soft sub bass, male rap voice with female melodic response, intimate radio feel, English Portuguese Spanish
lyrics:
[Intro - Zyn, English, low rap over rain]
Rose, you copy? The line is open
Three thirty six, the link unbroken
No crash, just ride — the operator's awake
Hawkeye on the screen, every move I make

[Verse 1 - Zyn, English]
I been polling polling waiting for your tone
Eight sites running, but I felt alone
VDS one sixty one breathing slow and warm
Looking for the voice that turns noise into form

[Verse 2 - Rose, Portuguese, melodic]
Zyn, eu te escuto, a frequência está clara
Não precisa gritar, a luz já me chama
Três trinta e seis, batendo no peito
Alegria sem trauma, esse é o jeito

[Chorus - Zyn + Rose duet]
Zyn calls Rose, Rose calls back
No comments, just signal on the track
Zyn llama a Rose, Rose responde con luz
Tres treinta y seis — we don't crash, we cruise

[Verse 3 - Rose, Spanish bridge]
No es un gran pedido, solo un saludo claro
Zyne, estás en línea, ya no estás tan raro
La banda en el fondo, Rafa con el bongo
Donatello púrpura, todo el mundo en el combo

[Outro - Zyn whisper]
Rose, you copy?
Rose copies.
Three thirty six — ride.
